tool_args.rationale: The long-horizon probe supplements the five short-window rows with observations at H=8, 15.5, and 23.8, including reversal near the target horizon. Fit the verified sink-coupled dual-horizon law numerically and request fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired long-horizon observations already constrain the guided five-parameter mechanism across both timescales.

considered_alternatives.option: Pure dual-exponential model without sink dependence
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It omits the observed sink-gradient effect and the verified joint mechanism.
The evidence and verified joint guidance instead support slow adaptation with sink-dependent fast gain.
